book.name: Mɑteu
book.title: LABAARI GEA NGE MƐ MATEU U YORUA

content: Yesun wɑsi ɡɔsiɑ
Sɔ̃ɔ nɔɔbɑ tiɑn biru Yesu Piɛɛ suɑ kɑ Yɑkɔbu kɑ Yohɑnu, Yɑkɔbun wɔnɔ, u kɑ bu dɑ ɡuu bɑkɑru ɡɑrun wɔllɔ be tɔnɑ.
Win wɑsi ɡɔsiɑ tuki ben nɔni sɔɔ, mɑ win wuswɑɑ bɑllimɔ nɡe sɔ̃ɔ, win yɑ̃nu mɑɑ bururɑ fem fem nɡe suru.
Yen biru bɑ Mɔwisi kɑ Eli wɑ bɑ kɑ Yesu ɡɑri mɔ̀.
Yerɑ Piɛɛ u Yesu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, Yinni, n wɑ̃ sɑ n wɑ̃ɑ mini. À n kĩ, kon kunu itɑ ko, teeru wunɛɡiru, teeru Mɔwisiɡiru, teeru mɑɑ Eliɡiru.
U ǹ ɡɑri yi ɡerum kpɑ, bukɔ kpiku ɡɑ kɑ bu wukiri. Mɑ bɑ nɔɔ ɡɑɡu nuɑ sɑɑ bukɔ min di ɡɑ nɛɛ, winiwɑ nɛn Bii kĩnɑsi wì sɔɔ nɛn ɡɔ̃ru dobu kpuro wɑ̃ɑ. I wiɡii swɑɑ dɑkio.
Ye bwɑ̃ɑ be, bɑ nɔɔ ɡe nuɑ bɛrum bu mwɑ sere bɑ wɔrumɑ bɑ wuswɑɑ tem ɡirɑri.
Yesu nɑ ben mi u bu nɔmɑ sɔndi u nɛɛ, i seewo, i ku bɛrum ko.
Ye bɑ wuswɑɑ seeyɑ bɑ ǹ mɑɑ ɡoo wɑ mɑ n kun mɔ Yesu turo.
Sɑnɑm mɛ bɑ sɑrɑm wee ɡuu ten min di, Yesu bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, bu ku rɑɑ ɡoo sɔ̃ ye bɑ wɑ mi, sere Tɔnun Bii u kɑ se ɡɔrin di.
Bwɑ̃ɑ be, bɑ nùn bikiɑ bɑ nɛɛ, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ woodɑ yɛ̃robɑ rɑ ɡere Eliwɑ koo ɡbi u nɑ.
U bu wisɑ u nɛɛ, kɑ ɡeemɑ Eli koo nɑ kpɑ u yɑbu bɑɑyere wesiɑ yen ɑyerɔ.
Adɑmɑ nɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ, Eli u nɑ kɔ, bɑ ǹ nùn tubɑ, mɑ bɑ nùn kuɑ nɡe mɛ bɑ kĩ. Nɡe mɛyɑ bɑ koo Tɔnun Biin tii nɔni sɔ̃.
Yerɑ n win bwɑ̃ɑbu yeeri mɑ Yohɑnu Bɑtɛmu kowon ɡɑriyɑ u mɔ̀.
Yesu u bii wi wɛrɛku ɡɑ wɑ̃ɑsi bɛkiɑ
Ye bɑ tunumɑ mi tɔn wɔru ɡɑ wɑ̃ɑ, durɔ ɡoo u nɑ u yiirɑ Yesun wuswɑɑɔ
u nɛɛ, Yinni, ɑ nɛn biin wɔnwɔndu wɑɑwo. U ɡiri kpɑkpɑnu bɑrɔ nu nùn wɑhɑlɑ mɔ̀ ɡem ɡem sere nu rɑ ɡɑsɔ nùn kpɛ̃ɛ dɔ̃ɔ sɔɔ ǹ kun mɛ nim sɔɔ.
Nɑ kɑ nùn wunɛn bwɑ̃ɑbu nɑɑwɑ ɑdɑmɑ bɑ kpɑnɑ bu nùn bɛkiɑ.
Yesu u nɛɛ, bɛɛ tɔn kɔ̃so nɑɑnɛ doke sɑriruɡibu, sere sɑɑ yerɑ̀ ko nɑ n kɑ bɛɛ wɑ̃ɑ. Nɡe sere dommɑ ko nɑ n kpɑm kɑ bɛɛ tɛmɑnɛ. I kɑ mɑn bii wi nɑɑwɑ mini.
Yesu u wɛrɛku ɡe ɡerusi mɑ ɡɑ bii wi doonɑri mɑ u bɛkurɑ mii mii.
Yerɑ Yesun bwɑ̃ɑbɑ dɑ win mi be tɔnɑ bɑ nùn bikiɑ bɑ nɛɛ, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ bɑ kpɑnɑ bu wɛrɛku ɡe ɡirɑ.

Yesu bu wisɑ u nɛɛ, yèn sɔ̃ bɛɛn nɑɑnɛ dokebu kun kpɑ̃. Kɑ ɡeemɑ nɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ, bɑɑ bɛɛn nɑɑnɛ dokebu bù n piibu sɑ̃ɑ nɡe dĩɑ bimɑ ye yɑ piiburu bo i ko ɡuu teni sɔ̃ tu wukuro minin di tu dɑ ɡiɔ. Mɛyɑ tɑ koo mɑɑ wukurɑ. Gɑ̃ɑnu mɑɑ sɑri ni i ko kpɑnɑ i ko. [
Adɑmɑ wɛrɛku ɡenin bweserɑ ku rɑ doonɛ mɑ n kun kɑ kɑnɑru kɑ nɔɔ bɔkuru.]
Yesu u kpɑm win ɡɔɔ
kɑ win seebun ɡɑri mɔ̀
Sɔ̃ɔ teeru nɡe mɛ bwɑ̃ɑ be, bɑ mɛnnɛ sɑnnu Gɑlileɔ Yesu bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, bɑ koo Tɔnun Bii tɔmbu nɔmɑ bɛriɑ
bu nùn ɡo, ɑdɑmɑ sɔ̃ɔ itɑse u koo se ɡɔrin di. Yerɑ bwɑ̃ɑ ben nukurɑ sɑnkirɑ ɡem ɡem.
Sɑ̃ɑ yerun wɔ̃ɔ ɡobin kɔsiɑbu
Sɑnɑm mɛ Yesu kɑ win bwɑ̃ɑbu bɑ turɑ Kɑpenɑmuɔ, yerɑ sɑ̃ɑ yerun wɔ̃ɔ ɡobiɡibɑ nɑ Piɛɛn mi bɑ nɛɛ, bɛɛn yinni u ku rɑ sɑ̃ɑ yerun wɔ̃ɔ ɡobi kɔsie?
Piɛɛ nɛɛ, ɑ, u rɑ kɔsie. Ye Piɛɛ u duɔ dirɔ Yesu ɡbiɑ u nùn bikiɑ u nɛɛ, ɑmɔnɑ ɑ wɑ Simɔɔ. Berɑ̀ n weenɛ bu hɑnduniɑ min sinɑmbu ɡbere ɡobi kɔsiɑ. Sinɑ bibu? Nɡe ɡɑbu.
Piɛɛ nɛɛ, ɡɑbu. Mɑ Yesu nɛɛ, ǹ n mɛn nɑ sinɑ bibu bɑ ǹ kɔsiɑmɔ.

Kɑ mɛ, sɑ ǹ kĩ su tɔn be mɔru kɔsiki. Yen sɔ̃, ɑ doo dɑɑrɔ ɑ kɔkɔru kɔ̃. Swɑ̃ɑ ye yɑ ɡbiɑ yɑ tu mwɛ, ɑ ye ɡɑwo ɑ yen nɔɔ bɑɑyɑ. Kɑɑ sii ɡeesun ɡobi wɑ mi, yi yi koo nɛ kɑ wunɛn ɡobi turi. A yi suo ɑ bu kɔsiɑ.
